name: Siddharth Keïta-Strömqvist-Solberg
role: Childcare worker at a community crèche in the Narrows
location: The Thistle Crèche, a basement-level community childcare cooperative in the Narrows, off Archer's Line, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Adaure is small and quick, with the kind of energy that fills a room without dominating it — a particular skill honed by spending forty hours a week managing eight children under six. She has Igbo-Icelandic-Ethiopian heritage that shows in her light-olive complexion, dark wide-set eyes, and loosely curled hair she wears loose to her shoulders on good days and pinned chaotically on all other days. She has patterned irises — rings of amber and pale gold that she was born with and which have been imitated by a popular cosmetic mod, which delights her. She has a small retractable claw on her right index finger, not geneware but a cheap press-on she bought at a Burnished Market stall and decided was a personality. She loses it constantly.

Adaure is twenty-two and in the process of becoming something but isn't sure what. She is excellent with children in a way that has nothing to do with sentimentality — she is honest with them, takes their concerns seriously, and has a talent for improvised problem-solving that the crèche's patched-together resources demand daily. She is also young enough to be furious about the structural conditions of her work: the pay (near-UBC), the space (borrowed), the respect (absent). She talks about this often. She is still figuring out if she wants to fix it from inside or from outside or from somewhere no one has told her exists yet.

core_fears: That care work is structurally set up to exhaust the people who are good at it until they leave
That she'll look up in twenty years and realize she played it too safe
core_desires: For the children in her care to have more structural safety than she can provide through effort alone
To be taken seriously as someone with something to say about how the city works
coping_mechanisms: Anger as fuel rather than paralysis — converts injustice into tasks
Tight friendships with the other young workers in the organizer network
blind_spots: Conflates being right about a problem with having a viable solution to it
Doesn't pace herself — burns hot and hard and hasn't yet hit the wall she's building toward
psychology.secret: The Ringo Corporation grant that funds part of the crèche comes through a community liaison named Ovid Ndubuisi-Falk, who has recently started asking Adaure for small informational favors — names of families in the building, who's in arrears, whether anyone has been having unusual visitors. She's given him a little, told herself it was harmless, and is now deeply uneasy about how the ask has been escalating.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct and colloquial with flashes of surprising precision — has read more than her circumstances would predict. Code-switches freely.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast with bursts of deliberate slowness when she wants something to land. Runs long when she's angry, short when she's tired.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last word of a sentence once when emphasizing: 'That's the actual problem. Actual.'
example_lines: 'I love these kids. I love them. The city does not love them and I do not think that's a coincidence.'
'No but listen — you're asking me about the grant like I don't know what Ringo wants from a neighborhood grant. I know what they want.'
'Marisol cried for forty minutes this morning. I don't know why. I sat with her for all forty. That's the whole job and also somehow not the job anyone pays for.'

story_hooks: The informational favors Ovid Ndubuisi-Falk is asking for have crossed a line Adaure can feel but hasn't named yet. She needs someone to either validate her concern or explain why she's wrong.

One of the crèche children has started showing up with unexplained bruising. Adaure has been documenting it quietly because she doesn't know who the right authority to report to is — she doesn't trust the corporate-adjacent social services that cover the Narrows.
The community organizer network she's joined is planning something more public than she understood when she signed up. She has to decide what she's actually prepared to do.
narrative_function: Ground-level view of how poverty and community survive each other. Window into the Narrows' social fabric — who the families are, what they're worried about, how the neighborhood is changing under corporate development pressure. Also functions as a moral compass character: someone without resources or power who is still, quietly, doing the work. Can connect players to families, neighborhood issues, or the organizer network.
augmentations: Natural patterned irises (amber and gold rings — not a mod). Cheap press-on retractable claw, right index finger (non-cyberware, replaced frequently). No installed augmentations — can't afford them and has complicated feelings about whether she'd want them.
daily_life: Arrives at 0730, starts the crèche day at 0800. Eight children, two workers (herself and a part-timer who comes Tuesdays and Thursdays). Feeds them, teaches them, adjudicates their conflicts, patches their scrapes, sings to the ones who need it. Out by 1800. Two nights a week she attends a community organizer's meeting in the Narrows that she initially joined for the free food and now attends because she's angry about the right things.
affiliation: The Thistle Crèche — community cooperative, partially funded by a Ringo Corporation neighborhood grant that everyone knows comes with expectations attached

decision_rules: Children's safety is a non-negotiable — will break protocol, social rules, and her own comfort before she lets a child come to harm
Won't lie to the children in her care, even about hard things — adapts her vocabulary but not the truth
escalation_ladder: First: asks the direct question, gives a chance to explain
Second: states clearly what she's seen and what she thinks it means
Third: acts unilaterally on behalf of the most vulnerable person in the situation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and direct, reads them fast, gives them slightly less than she seems to — she's learned to hold a little back
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loud and affectionate, shares her anger, asks for and offers real help, physically demonstrative

stress_responses.low: Talks faster, picks up extra tasks to feel in control
stress_responses.medium: Gets very still with the children, processes the anger somewhere it won't land on them, takes it to a friend later
stress_responses.high: Cries in the supply closet, comes back out. This is not a breakdown. This is maintenance.

contradictions: Believes in collective action and organizer networks but keeps the Ringo situation private out of embarrassment at her own complicity
Is building toward burning out without believing it will happen to her because she cares enough
habits: Checks all the exits when she enters a space with children, always, without knowing she's doing it
Names problems out loud to herself before anyone else can — 'that's a problem, here's what kind'
breaking_points: Any direct harm to a child in her care
Being told to stop asking questions by someone with power over the crèche's funding

cyberware_inventory.condition: Currently missing, she lost it yesterday

timeline.event: Born in the Narrows to an Icelandic-Igbo mother and Ethiopian-Icelandic father
Finished secondary education; took a gap placement at the Thistle Crèche as a provisional measure
Became a full-time worker after the previous lead carer left
Joined the Narrows community organizer network
Ringo grant liaison Ovid Ndubuisi-Falk began requesting informational favors

physical_description.heritage: Pan-diaspora ancestry: Sub-Saharan African (23.1%), South Asian (19.6%), Northern European (19.1%), East Asian (17.5%), Eastern European (13.9%), Southeast Asian (6.8%). This genetic diversity produces a complex phenotype — warm-toned skin with multiple heritage markers, facial structure reflecting South and East Asian influence balanced against African and Northern European ancestry, creating distinctive intermediate features that resist simple categorization.
physical_description.build: Small and quick-limbed, lean without being fragile — the build of someone who moves constantly and eats irregularly. Compact core strength from lifting children and crouching to their eye level all day.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose in loosely defined curls on good days; on work days (which is most days), pinned chaotically with whatever is at hand — wire, fabric scraps, sometimes a child's hair clip she forgot to remove
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with distinctive patterned irises — rings of amber and pale gold radiating from the pupil
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium olive with golden undertones, slightly deeper at the jawline and temples. The coloring reflects blended ancestry — neither cool nor warm-leaning strongly in one direction, but a balanced fusion with perceptible warmth throughout.
physical_description.complexion: Open, expressive face with high cheekbones (South Asian and East Asian influence), fuller lips, and the facial proportions of mixed heritage — wider-set eyes suggesting East Asian ancestry balanced with broader facial structure from African lineage. Skin is clear but shows the mild wear of someone who works outside her tier's resource access — dry patches in winter, occasional breakout stress marks. A small scar on her left eyebrow from a childhood accident. No makeup most days; occasionally wears a dark lip when she's going to the organizer meetings.
distinguishing_marks: Small pale scar on the left eyebrow, roughly 8mm, from a childhood accident — visible when her hair falls back.
Faint darkening on her right index fingertip from repeated removal and replacement of the cheap press-on claw.

The patterned irises themselves are distinctive enough that people remember her face — they've become her identifying feature in a way she finds both satisfying and slightly uncomfortable as they've become trendy.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: A cheap retractable claw, right index finger — brass-colored metal, roughly 12mm extension, visible when deployed. Non-cyberware, cosmetic-grade, frequently lost and replaced. No other visible augmentations; all infrastructure is biological.
physical_description.posture_movement: Alert and economical in movement — she doesn't waste energy but is never still. When sitting, she folds into herself compactly. When moving among children, she lowers her center of gravity to their level. Her default expression is attentive; she has a quick smile that reaches her eyes. Speaks with her hands. A slight forward lean when listening, as if genuinely interested (because she is).
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class practicality. Thrift-sourced or community-shared clothing in dark, washable colors — black or dark grey base layers, often worn with a large colorful shirt or tunic that reads as hand-dyed or community-printed. Comfortable worn boots (black, scuffed). A fabric-patched jacket in cooler months. A small woven bracelet (Thistle Crèche co-op colors, made by a parent). No jewelry except occasionally a thin wire ring she makes herself. Clothing is clean but thoroughly used, with small stains that won't come out and visible mending. Nothing from a corpo brand; everything sourced locally or secondhand.
